prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in links your pet to cloud storage so your progress is never lost.", "Safe Cloud Sync Enabled"]
1: ["Secure Your Desktop Companion", "Link your pet to your account to preserve customization and restore across devices.", "Cloud Save Active"]
2: ["Give Your Pet a Personality", "Choose key personality traits and give your new pet a unique name.", "Pet Nickname", "Select Personality"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Interact with your pet right on stage to see how it moves and reacts."]
4: ["Use a clear, bright, front-facing photo for optimal AI pet rendering.", "Photo Quality Checklist"]
5: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Sanctuary", "Meet your future desktop friends and start a cozy journey together."]
6: ["App running in System Tray", "Look for the pet icon near your system clock to manage or unhide your pet."]
7: ["Building desktop pet animations..."]
8: ["New to desktop pets? Quick Adoption takes less than 1 minute!", "Fastest Option"]
9: ["Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack!"]

verdicts.problem: Suggests bypassing or skipping onboarding steps
